in_arabic.name: خزرة

in_urdu.name: خزرة

in_hindi.name: खिज़रा
in_hindi.meaning: खिज़रा का अर्थ है हरा पौधा या ताज़ा फूल
in_hindi.long_meaning: खिज़रा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ख-ज़-र' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है हरा पौधा या ताज़ा फूल, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रकृति की सुंदरता और शुद्धता का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: خزره
in_pashto.meaning: خزره د معنی دی زرغون بوټی یا تازه ګل
in_pashto.long_meaning: د خزره نوم د عربي ريښې 'خ-ز-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د زرغون بوټي يا تازه ګل معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو او کلتور سره تړاو لري

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Khizra" is derived from the Arabic word for Venus, al-Najm, which means "the star". In Islamic culture, the name is traditionally associated with Al-Khidr, a righteous servant of God mentioned in both the Quran and many Hadiths. He is described as a wise, patient, and grateful person who acts as a guide to prophets and messengers of God.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Khizra" lies in its association with Al-Khidr, who is seen as a symbol of guidance and wisdom. The name is a reminder of God's presence and guidance in our lives. The star Venus, which is also known as the Morning Star, is seen as a symbol of hope and renewal in many different cultural and religious traditions. In Islam, the name "Khizra" represents the idea that, no matter how difficult or dark our circumstances may seem, God is always with us and will guide us through the challenges of life. The name also serves as a reminder to be patient and grateful, as Al-Khidr was known for his remarkable patience and appreciation for the divine plan.
